# A shape that draws itself is refused, rather than expanding forever.
#
# passShapeDraw expands a composed shape's body into the calls that paint it,
# and a recursive one meets the same call again. It ran until the process died,
# with nothing said -- `sngl generate` on the program below never returned.
#
# The other inliners leave a recursive component standing and let the target
# instantiate it at run time. That is not open here: a drawing is the list of
# calls that paint it, and there is no node left for a target to instantiate.
#
# A script test because the refusal needs a target picked -- the pass is gated
# on the `canvas` want, which a build resolves and a fixture has no way to say.
#
# `n = 3` rather than `n = depth` would fold the recursion away at build time
# and never reach the pass, which is the second half of the claim: a bounded
# recursion still compiles.

! sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out .
stderr 'nest draws itself'
stderr 'no depth to stop at'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

// A var, so the recursion is not folded away before lowering sees it.
var depth = 3

component nest(n int) draw.shape {
    draw.circle(cx=1.0, cy=1.0, r=1.0)

    if n > 0 {
        nest(n=n - 1)
    }
}

ui.window #w(title="t") {
    draw.canvas(width=10px, height=10px) {
        nest(n=depth)
    }
}
